_comment: The six-month engagement, deliverable by deliverable. This is the client-facing commitment record. Deliverables come from reference/01-roadmap.md (the Notion roadmap Cavallo was shown); every status must carry dated evidence or say plainly that none exists. Status vocabulary is validated by lib/phases.ts — an unknown value throws.
source: reference/01-roadmap.md — the client-facing Notion roadmap. No proposal, SOW or email record exists in this repo; see docs/HANDOFF-2026-08-04.md open question 4.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.outcome: Site out of holding pattern. Team can resume publishing into the new content architecture.
phases.note: All three pillar pages are built and render on cavallo.seo.markroberts.io. None are on production. Mark's call, 2026-08-05: they do not publish while they still carry coming-soon links. So the remaining Phase 1 work is not building — it is resolving the spoke gaps, then publishing.
teamRole: Prepare Carole's laminitis draft for Phase 2

deliverables.title: Pillar 1 live — The Hoof Boot Guide
deliverables.promised: Commercial hub enriching the existing /product-category/hoof-boot/ category page. Guide copy wraps the product grid; every product page links back here.
deliverables.evidence: Verified 2026-08-05. Renders on the preview site with 9 hub sections, 12 FAQs, valid FAQPage JSON-LD and a semantic comparison table. Absent from cavallo-inc.com. Render code is on the `seo` branch; the copy lives in ACF term fields in the WordPress DB and must be re-entered on live by hand.

deliverables.title: Pillar 2 live — Hoof Health & Conditions
deliverables.promised: Net-new authority pillar at /horse-hoof-care/ targeting horse hoof anatomy (2,400/mo) and horse hoof care (600/mo). Overview hub linking one canonical per condition.
deliverables.evidence: Verified 2026-08-05. Built on preview: anatomy figure, 'how these conditions relate' framing, vet guardrail panel, FAQPage + Article schema, ~6 H2s. 404 on cavallo-inc.com. Links only to spokes that already exist — navicular, thrush and DSLD are deliberately unlinked until Phases 2 and 5, so no coming-soon dependency blocks it.
defects: H1 renders a mangled unicode escape — 'Hoof Health u0026 Conditions' instead of '&'. Eight occurrences on the page, including the H1 and one H2.
Yoast title and meta description are unset, so the page serves the theme default 'Hoof Health & Conditions - Cavallo'.
Links to /sensitive-thin-soled-horses-rejoice/, which returns 404 on production.
Two H1s render — the theme's screen-reader H1 plus the pillar-header block's H1.

deliverables.title: Pillar 3 live — Barefoot Horse Care
deliverables.promised: Net-new credibility pillar at /barefoot-horse-care/, anchored on the wild-horse self-trimming model. Old /category/the-barefoot-horse/ archive 301s into it.
deliverables.blockedBy: Two KD-0 spokes that two of its H2s point at do not exist: wild-horse hooves (how do wild horses maintain their hooves, 600 + how do wild horses trim their hooves, 700 + wild horse hooves, 500) and barefoot trimming (horse hoof trimming, 200). The build spec requires these first — the pillar page is gated on them.
deliverables.evidence: Verified 2026-08-05. Built on preview with 5 content sections, FAQ block, and Yoast title and meta correctly set. 404 on cavallo-inc.com. This is the one pillar with a hard documented publish gate.

deliverables.title: Internal linking framework
deliverables.promised: Every page on the site connects logically — a two-tier model where the pillar links one canonical per topic and each canonical carries its own spokes.
deliverables.evidence: The model is specified and both new pillar pages implement their half of it. Two gaps remain. The canonical spoke briefs — the layer that makes each canonical carry its onward spoke links — are called out in the strategy as the biggest missing piece and are not written; without them spokes orphan the moment a canonical ships. And still true from the June audit: 723 pages have zero internal inbound links, 632 have no meta description.

deliverables.title: Full content audit
deliverables.promised: Identify which of the 300+ existing pages can be repurposed vs. need to be created from scratch.
deliverables.evidence: Delivered as state/pages.csv — 1,155 rows, exactly one role per URL, which is what prevents cannibalization. Re-scored against measured Search Console data 2026-08-05: the map captures 90.1% of measured clicks, so it is structurally sound. But it was originally scored on Ahrefs estimates that undercounted traffic-bearing pages by roughly 14x, and 153 decisions are still outstanding: 87 destructive rows (44 PRUNE, 39 MERGE+301, 4 NOINDEX) that earn 10 or more measured clicks, plus 66 URLs earning 10 or more clicks that were never audited at all because Ahrefs could not see them.

phases.title: Laminitis Guide + Categories Locked
phases.outcome: Laminitis guide live and ranking. Shop categories locked and ready for the nav funnel build.
phases.note: The laminitis cluster is the highest-volume single topic in the project (~10,000 monthly US searches) and almost every SERP carries an AI Overview. Head terms are an aspirational page-1 and AI-citation play, not top-5: the top 5 is walled by Merck, ACVS, NIH and vet schools.

deliverables.title: Carole's laminitis draft delivered
deliverables.promised: Carole supplies her existing laminitis draft for SEO optimization (carried over from the Phase 1 team commitments).
deliverables.evidence: Mark confirmed 2026-08-05: Carole has completed the laminitis guide and it is ready to be built.

deliverables.title: Laminitis guide SEO-optimized and published
deliverables.promised: Restructure and medical-depth expansion of /your-cavallo-laminitis-healing-plan/ so it owns laminitis (5,500) and laminitis in horses (4,500). Explicitly a rebuild, not a light optimize — the existing page is FAQ and product-framed.
deliverables.evidence: Carole's draft is in hand but not built. Measured on production 2026-08-05: the page has no FAQPage schema, no MedicalWebPage schema, and only three H2s — so none of the AI-citation build standard is applied yet. It currently ranks #10 for 'laminitic hoof' and does not rank the head terms. Around ten MERGE+301 donors point into this URL, so optimizing it unblocks the largest merge cluster in the project.

deliverables.title: Laminitis guide connected into the Hoof Health pillar
deliverables.promised: The optimized guide is wired into Pillar 2 as the laminitis canonical, with the commercial boots-for-laminitis intent kept off it.
deliverables.evidence: Verified 2026-08-05: Pillar 2 already links /your-cavallo-laminitis-healing-plan/ on the preview site, and the commercial /faq/cavallo-hoof-boots-for-laminitis/ is correctly kept off the pillar. Neither page is on production, so the connection is not live.

deliverables.title: Mid-project measurement check
deliverables.promised: Compare metrics against the June 2026 baseline.
deliverables.blockedBy: state/gsc.json has a null click count for every month, so there is no trend line to measure against. The monthly series needs fixing before any before/after comparison is possible.
deliverables.evidence: The June baseline itself is locked (DR 48, 236 organic keywords, ~3,069 monthly organic traffic, ~5,565 GA4 sessions, ~$31,981 monthly organic revenue). The problem is the current-period series, not the baseline.
